\newcommand{\LetterBody}{I am applying my experience in product operations and service analytics to the Product Operations Analyst role. At Northstar Labs, I coordinated a quarterly planning cycle across six teams, turning delivery risks into a shared review that helped leaders make earlier trade-offs. I also built a support-trend dashboard with engineering and customer success, giving the team a clearer view of recurring issues and the work most likely to reduce them.\par
In my current role at Cedar Works, I guide cross-functional launches from discovery through post-release review. I set practical milestones, surface dependencies, and keep decisions visible when priorities change. A recent workflow redesign reduced handoffs between support and implementation, while a weekly feedback review helped the team focus on fixes that mattered to customers. I value careful measurement, plain-language communication, and plans that remain useful when new information arrives.\par
I also maintain a written record of decisions, follow up on open questions, and share concise updates with the people affected by each change. This helps colleagues understand what has changed, what evidence informed a decision, and where further work is needed before a release.
\par
I would welcome the opportunity to bring this approach to your team. I can help connect operating details to customer outcomes, make progress easier to understand, and support steady improvement without losing sight of the people doing the work. Thank you for considering my application.}
